items.title: Marty Napoleon interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York, New York, January 16, 1999
items.q: He said, 'listen, would you like to work with Charlie Barnet’s band?' I said, 'get out of here, give me that again, for real?' ... 'Okay you’ve got it.' ... Now we’re at the Strand

ctx.x: My goodness. And then you went on to Lee Castle and Charlie Barnet.
Charlie Barnet. That was a story, Charlie Barnet’s band. I was reading Down Beat magazine. You got your own list —
I’ve got my own list here.
